_about: Batch 25 Magic AFK spells (R5). Ids, levels, runes and xp from the design notes (javap on server.jar, 2026-10-30). fallback = the next spell down the ladder (refinement 7.1); trainTo = the Magic level the refusal names. delay = ticks between casts (UNVERIFIED: the server's own magic delay decides; a cast refused for the delay counts toward 'cast failed twice'). staffs: rune id -> staff ids that stand in for it when wielded.
